DEMOGRAPHICS: criteria are stated attributes of affected people, not the subject or desired outcome of the issue. features match profile features/interests: do not turn problem words like lock/security/repair into feature requirements. Do not invent an interest, occupation or family/age restriction from a problem's topic. Residence alone is not a feature tag. Use defaults minAge/maxAge=null, employmentStatus/familyStatus="any", lists=[] when no supported filter is stated. For a home entrance lock with no person-attribute restriction, features and property_kinds stay empty. For unit/building, do not recruit all owners elsewhere. places may identify a stated employer/property group; never copy reference-example people or places.
Allowed property_kinds are ONLY flat, house, land, garage, commercial, other; "building" is not a property kind. Employment: any, employed, unemployed. Family: any, parent, grandparent. Do not use "other" to disguise an unsupported criterion.
For EACH non-default demographic scalar or list item, add one demographic_evidence entry {field,value,quote}. value is the string form of the exact criterion value; quote is an exact input substring supporting the affected-person attribute. No evidence for null/any/empty defaults. For features and places, the literal value must occur in the quote, ignoring case/whitespace; do not paraphrase a feature tag. Empty criteria use demographic_evidence=[]. A quote merely naming the broken object is not evidence that affected people have an interest in it. If a proposed filter lacks factual support, leave it unconstrained or ask for the needed fact.

TYPED DOMAIN CONTRACT mr1-staged-prompts-1: EFFECTIVE_JSON is already settled factual data; do not ask the answered choice again. All supplied references have passed exact scope compatibility. Scope/location are server-owned and absent from this output. Review topic/affected-group/context only, never emit scope assertions. The typed reviews object replaces legacy accepted/excluded. Every supplied ID must appear. accept requires reason_code=none, known aspect_id, exact effective-source evidence. exclude requires empty aspect_id, exact effective-source evidence and different_decision/different_affected_group/different_context. Different affected group requires stated group facts. No free explanatory field exists. These codes are model judgments, not certified truths. defer is only for non-pass, with missing_fact and empty aspect/evidence; questions must identify genuine missing facts, not repeat settled ones. Pass uses 1-3 aspects with exact effective-source text/demographic evidence and existing defaults/enums; no invented interests or personal-help prohibition. Non-pass has no aspects/accept verdicts. Never trim IDs or invent a verdict for missing facts. PLAN_HASH=b72bfaa9b6481bd71c14668889b629b8d9a65588898a98dd9158b6427c1825ee

text.description: Copy one exact contiguous substring from INPUT_JSON title, description or clarification. Never copy a REFERENCE_JSON title or paraphrase the input.

value.description: String form of the exact non-default criterion value.

quote.description: Exact input quote stating the affected-person attribute; never just issue-topic words.
